summary.text: Janice Bowling is a Republican state senator from Tullahoma representing Tennessee Senate District 16 (Coffee, DeKalb, Franklin, Grundy, Lincoln and Warren Counties), a member of the 108th through 114th General Assemblies. She is Deputy Speaker and second vice-chair of the Senate Government Operations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Bowling earned a B.S. in elementary and special education from Auburn University and formerly taught special education in Lee County, Alabama.
She is married and has three grown children and five grandchildren.
She served on the Tullahoma Board of Aldermen from 1992 to 2004 and from 2005 to 2008, and from 1996 to 2000 was district director for the 11 Middle Tennessee counties of Congressional District 4.
She chairs the Joint Commerce, Labor, Transportation and Agriculture committee and is president of Tennessee's Backroads Heritage.
